title: Build Your First Network — Assemble the Five Pieces
key_insight: A small project needs data batches, a model, a matching loss, an optimizer, and a loop that repeats prediction and correction.
body:
## Assemble the Five Pieces

Layers, losses, and optimizers make sense separately, but a model learns only when they are connected in the right order.

A small project needs data batches, a model, a matching loss, an optimizer, and a loop that repeats prediction and correction.

Start with a tiny known dataset. A simple task makes wiring mistakes easier to see before scale hides them.
common_mistakes: A model learns merely because its script exits successfully.
Only the final accuracy number is needed to reproduce a run.
Validation rows should be used for every weight update.
mini_exercise: Sketch the situation in “Assemble the Five Pieces” as three labeled steps, then explain what changes at each step.
real_world_usage: This capstone proves the learner can connect Phase 5’s parts into a working training system.
explain_back_prompt: Using the “Assemble the Five Pieces” situation, explain Build Your First Network without assuming the listener knows deep learning.
